newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia's olive oil output put at 250,000 tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia's olive oil output put at 250,000 tonnes.

text.p: Tunisia said its olive oil output for this season would be more than 250,000 tonnes, up on an official forecast in October of more than 200,000 tonnes and more than four times last season's output.
The revised figure was released on Wednesday at the parliamentary debates of the agriculture ministry budget for 1997.
Last season saw output of only 60,000 tonnes because of a drought in the last two years. The last output record was achieved in the 1991/1992 season with 280,000 tonnes.
The 1996/1997 olive oil season started on November 15.
